rationale: The lifecycle change is limited to driver-warning presentation (new visual layout and notification presentation). The supplied description explicitly states that obstacle information, object category information, ego-object spatial information, the Phenomenon of Interest, and the Evaluation Target are unchanged. In the frozen baseline, the ORRs depend on obstacle presence, object category, or braking-relevant spatial information and their associated revalidation conditions; none of these are affected by a presentation-only change. Therefore there is no representational impact on the existing ORRs.
